name: What are the most common mistakes in primary bathroom remodeling?

mainEntity.name: What mistakes cause primary bathroom remodels to run over budget, fail inspections, or look cheap after completion?
mainEntity.text: What mistakes cause primary bathroom remodels to run over budget, fail inspections, or look cheap after completion?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common mistakes in primary bathroom remodeling are planning errors, not design mistakes. Homeowners often change the layout after construction starts, choose products too late, or underestimate how much waterproofing and inspection work matters. Another frequent issue is focusing too much on appearance while neglecting ventilation, storage, and lighting. Low-quality tile installation, poor grout detailing, and weak fixture placement can make even expensive materials look average. Comparing bids only by price can also lead to incomplete scopes and expensive change orders later. The best way to avoid these problems is to finalize the layout early, set clear material allowances, and work with a contractor who explains the full process before demolition begins. A well-planned remodel looks better, lasts longer, and is less likely to exceed budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common mistakes include changing the layout too late, underestimating waterproofing, choosing fixtures before measuring, skipping ventilation improvements, and comparing bids only by price. Poor lighting, weak storage planning, and low-quality tile installation also make the finished bathroom feel less luxurious than intended.
